question: How can I register for an internship?
answer: You can register by creating an account and completing the internship application form on our platform.

question: What documents are required for registration?
answer: You need a valid ID proof college ID or Aadhar and your latest educational marksheet to complete registration.

question: Is there any registration fee for the internship?
answer: No there is no registration fee for applying to the internship program.

question: Can I register using my college email ID?
answer: Yes you can register using either your personal email ID or your college email ID.

question: How long does the registration process take?
answer: The registration process usually takes less than 10 minutes if you have all documents ready.

question: Can I edit my registration details after submitting?
answer: Yes you can edit your registration details from the account settings page before the internship starts.

question: What is the process to sign up on the platform?
answer: You can sign up by clicking the register button and filling in your basic details and education info.

question: Do I need a resume to register?
answer: A resume is optional during registration but recommended for internship tracks that require shortlisting.

question: Can school students register for the internship?
answer: No currently only college and university students are eligible to register for our internships.

question: Is there an age limit for registration?
answer: Applicants must be at least 18 years old to register for any internship program.

question: What happens after I complete registration?
answer: After registration you will receive a confirmation email and can start browsing available internship tracks.

question: Can I register from a mobile phone?
answer: Yes the registration form is mobile friendly and works on any smartphone browser.

question: How do I verify my registered email address?
answer: Click the verification link sent to your inbox right after registration to activate your account.

question: What is the duration of the internship program?
answer: The internship program typically runs for 4 to 12 weeks depending on the track you choose.

question: How do I apply for an internship?
answer: You can apply for an internship by browsing available tracks and clicking the apply button on your dashboard.

question: Can I do multiple internships at the same time?
answer: Currently our platform allows you to enroll in only one internship track at a time.

question: Is the internship online or offline?
answer: All our internships are conducted completely online through the learning platform.

question: What internship tracks are currently available?
answer: We currently offer tracks in web development data science AI and machine learning and digital marketing.

question: Will I get a stipend during the internship?
answer: Stipends depend on the specific internship track and are mentioned on the internship details page.

question: Is prior experience required to join the internship?
answer: No prior experience is required for most beginner level internship tracks.

question: How many hours per week does the internship require?
answer: Most internship tracks require around 8 to 10 hours of work per week.

question: Can I switch my internship track after starting?
answer: Track switching is allowed only within the first week and requires coordinator approval.

question: Is the internship recognized by companies?
answer: Yes our internship certificates are recognized and valued by many hiring partner companies.

question: What is the eligibility criteria for the internship?
answer: Any currently enrolled college student with a stable internet connection is eligible to join.

question: Can working professionals join the internship?
answer: Yes working professionals can also join as long as they can dedicate the required weekly hours.

question: Does the internship offer a letter of recommendation?
answer: Top performing interns may receive a letter of recommendation from their mentor at the end.

question: How do I know which internship track suits me?
answer: You can take the short skill assessment quiz on the homepage to get track recommendations.

question: How do I submit my project?
answer: You can submit your completed project through the project submission section on your dashboard.

question: What is the last date to submit my project?
answer: The submission deadline is displayed on your dashboard under the specific internship track details.

question: Can I resubmit my project after the deadline?
answer: Late submissions may be accepted with a penalty only if enabled by the internship coordinator.

question: What file formats are accepted for project submission?
answer: We accept ZIP files GitHub repository links and PDF reports for project submission.

question: How will I know if my project submission was successful?
answer: You will receive a confirmation message and email once your project submission is successfully recorded.

question: Can I submit my project in a team?
answer: Team submissions are allowed only for tracks that explicitly mention group projects.

question: What is the maximum file size for submission?
answer: The maximum allowed upload size for a single project submission is 50 megabytes.

question: Can I submit a project link instead of uploading a file?
answer: Yes you can paste a GitHub or Google Drive link instead of uploading the file directly.

question: What happens if I miss the submission deadline completely?
answer: Missing the deadline without an extension may result in disqualification from receiving the certificate.

question: Can I request an extension for project submission?
answer: Extensions can be requested by contacting your mentor before the original deadline passes.

question: How do I check my submission status?
answer: You can check your submission status anytime under the My Submissions tab on your dashboard.

question: What kind of projects will I work on?
answer: You will work on real world projects such as building applications dashboards or machine learning models depending on your track.

question: Are project topics assigned or can I choose my own?
answer: You can either choose from a list of suggested project topics or propose your own idea for approval.

question: How many projects do I need to complete during the internship?
answer: Most tracks require you to complete one major capstone project by the end of the internship.

question: Can I use the project for my resume or portfolio?
answer: Yes you are encouraged to showcase your completed projects in your resume and personal portfolio.

question: Will I get feedback on my project?
answer: Yes mentors review submitted projects and provide detailed feedback within a week.

question: Can I collaborate with other interns on a project?
answer: Collaboration is allowed for tracks that support group based project work.

question: Is there a list of sample project ideas?
answer: Yes a curated list of sample project ideas is available under the resources section for each track.

question: Can I change my project topic midway?
answer: You can change your project topic within the first two weeks with mentor approval.

question: Do I need to present my project to a panel?
answer: Some advanced tracks require a short virtual presentation of your final project to a review panel.

question: When will I receive my certificate?
answer: Your certificate will be issued after successful completion of all internship requirements.

question: How can I download my certificate?
answer: You can download your certificate as a PDF from the certificates section of your dashboard.

question: Is the certificate verified and authentic?
answer: Yes every certificate comes with a unique verification ID that can be checked on our website.

question: Will I get a certificate if I miss the project deadline?
answer: Certificates are issued only after project submission requirements are fully met.

question: Can I get a certificate without completing the internship?
answer: No a certificate is issued only upon successful completion of the entire internship program.

question: How long is the certificate valid for?
answer: The certificate does not expire and remains valid permanently as proof of completion.

question: Can I get a printed physical copy of my certificate?
answer: Currently we only issue digital PDF certificates and do not offer printed physical copies.

question: What details are mentioned on the certificate?
answer: The certificate includes your name internship track duration and a unique verification code.

question: How do I share my certificate on LinkedIn?
answer: You can use the built in Add to LinkedIn button available next to your downloaded certificate.

question: Can I request a correction on my certificate if my name is wrong?
answer: Yes you can raise a correction request through the support team with proof of your correct name.

question: Will the certificate mention my project score or grade?
answer: No the certificate confirms completion only and does not display individual project scores.

question: How can I update my account details?
answer: You can update your account details from the profile settings page after logging in.

question: I forgot my account password what should I do?
answer: You can reset your password using the forgot password link on the login page.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: You can request account deletion by contacting our support team through the help center.

question: Can I change my registered email address?
answer: Yes you can change your registered email address from the account settings page.

question: How do I update my profile picture?
answer: You can update your profile picture by going to the profile section and uploading a new image.

question: Why is my account showing as inactive?
answer: Your account may show inactive if email verification was not completed after registration.

question: Can I have two accounts on the platform?
answer: No each user is allowed to maintain only one active account on our platform.

question: How do I change my phone number on my account?
answer: You can update your registered phone number from the account settings under contact information.

question: Why can I not log into my account?
answer: Please double check your email and password or use the forgot password option to reset access.

question: How do I enable two factor authentication for my account?
answer: You can enable two factor authentication from the security tab inside your account settings.

question: What payment methods are accepted for paid programs?
answer: We accept credit cards debit cards UPI and net banking for all paid programs.

question: Will I get a refund if I cancel my enrollment?
answer: Refunds are processed according to our refund policy within 7 business days of cancellation.

question: Is there an installment option for course fees?
answer: Yes installment options are available for select paid internship and course programs.

question: How do I get an invoice for my payment?
answer: An invoice is automatically generated and sent to your registered email after every payment.

question: What should I do if my payment fails?
answer: If your payment fails please retry after some time or contact support with your transaction ID.

question: Are there any hidden charges apart from the listed fee?
answer: No there are no hidden charges beyond the fee amount displayed at checkout.

question: Can I pay the internship fee in a different currency?
answer: Payments are currently accepted only in Indian Rupees through the supported payment gateways.

question: How long does a refund take to reflect in my account?
answer: Refunds usually take 5 to 7 business days to reflect back in your original payment method.

question: Do you offer any discounts or scholarships on fees?
answer: Yes need based scholarships and seasonal discount coupons are occasionally available on select programs.

question: The website is not loading properly what should I do?
answer: Please clear your browser cache and cookies or try accessing the website from a different browser.

question: I am unable to upload my project file what should I do?
answer: Please ensure your file size is within the allowed limit and try uploading again using a stable internet connection.

question: The video lectures are not playing how do I fix this?
answer: Try switching to a different browser or check your internet connection as video streaming needs a stable connection.

question: How do I report a bug on the platform?
answer: You can report a bug by using the feedback form available in the help section of the platform.

question: I am not receiving verification emails what should I do?
answer: Please check your spam folder or add our email address to your contacts list to receive verification emails.

question: Who do I contact for urgent technical issues?
answer: You can contact our technical support team through the live chat option available on the platform.

question: The mobile app keeps crashing what should I do?
answer: Please update the app to its latest version or reinstall it if the crashing issue continues.

question: Why is my dashboard showing outdated information?
answer: Try refreshing the page or logging out and back in as the dashboard may need to resync your data.

question: I cannot access my course after payment what should I do?
answer: Please wait a few minutes for the system to sync or contact support with your payment receipt.

question: How do I clear cache on the platform to fix loading issues?
answer: Go to your browser settings and clear the browsing data and cache for the last 24 hours.

question: What is the process to sign up for a workshop?
answer: Workshops can be joined by registering separately through the events section of your dashboard.

question: How do I know if my registration was successful?
answer: You will see a green success message and receive a confirmation email once registration is complete.

question: Can I get an internship extension if I need more time?
answer: Extensions are granted on a case by case basis by contacting your assigned mentor.

question: Does the internship include live mentorship sessions?
answer: Yes weekly live mentorship sessions are scheduled for all active internship tracks.

question: How do I upload multiple files for one submission?
answer: You can compress multiple files into a single ZIP folder before uploading for submission.

question: Can I preview my project before final submission?
answer: Yes a preview option is available so you can review your submission before confirming it.

question: Do you provide project templates to get started?
answer: Yes starter templates for common project types are available in the resources library.

question: Is a certificate issued for workshops as well?
answer: Yes a separate participation certificate is issued for each completed workshop.

question: How do I recover my account if I lost access to my email?
answer: Please contact support with alternate proof of identity to recover access to your account.

question: Can I switch my payment plan after enrolling?
answer: Switching payment plans is possible within the first week by contacting the billing team.

question: Why did my card get declined during payment?
answer: Card declines usually happen due to insufficient funds or bank security restrictions on online payments.

question: The chatbot or help widget is not responding what do I do?
answer: Please refresh the page and try again or reach out through the alternate email support option.

question: How do I check my internet speed if the platform is slow?
answer: You can use any free online speed test tool to confirm if slow internet is causing the issue.
